name: Lucia Macchia

events.title: Second marriage, to Donato Sena
events.description: Per FS tree; Donato Sena c.1800-1861.

bioAdditions: The FamilySearch tree spells her surname Macchia, matching Round 3's tentative reading 'Macchia(?)' in the 1867 act (S1). It gives her birth as 8 Apr 1812 and her death as 9 May 1880 in Bisaccia, and names her parents as Nicola Macchia (c.1782–1817) and Grazia Maria Gallicchio (c.1785–1855) (S1, S2). Widowed in 1848, she remarried Donato Sena on 28 Sep 1850. One FS source is a FamilySearch-indexed Avellino record (ark 1:1:6J4L-ZFYY) that groups her with Savino, Angelamaria Fede and 'Francesco': this is the 1867 marriage act of her son.
